mentions.name: love
mentions.description: A terminal-based text editor that supports loading and editing files, copy/paste, and text selection. Planned next steps are tree-sitter integration for syntax highlighting and LSP support.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on my terminal editor, but I parked that for now -- https://github.com/bloomca/love. It is possible to load a file and edit it, copy/paste works, you can select text, etc.
